domains.doc: Sentinel value indicating the message body MUST NOT be encrypted (always serialized as cleartext JSON). Surfaces on mq-messages.spec entries whose payload is non-PII; the message author MUST also document `encryptionReason` on the spec entry justifying the choice.

Public framework fixture domain for the sealed-path unit tests of EncryptionDomainModes + EncryptedBodyComposer. Not a production keyring domain - a host registers its own sealed domains at composition time.
